patches.name: Add music sources
patches.description: Adds music apps to the list of sources RoadSync can browse and control from the handlebar. Apps must expose a media browser service to be browsable.

options.title: Music app packages
options.description: Package names of the music apps to add. An app is only browsable if it declares an android.media.browse.MediaBrowserService; apps without one keep working as plain transport control targets and do not need to be listed here.
